items.before: The declaration checkbox is now the smaller GOV.UK style, inside a group whose label only screen readers hear. The page no longer shows the Draft or Amend tag, the reference or Cancel amend above its heading, on a first submission or an amendment. Plants' declaration makes the same changes.
items.after:
The declaration checkbox is now the smaller GOV.UK style.

It sits inside a group whose label only screen readers hear.

The page no longer shows these above its heading:

- the Draft or Amend tag
- the reference
- Cancel amend

This applies on a first submission and on an amendment.

Plants' declaration makes the same changes.

items.before: Declaration page: small checkbox in a hidden-legend fieldset, and no status strip
items.after: Declaration page: a small checkbox in a group with a label only screen readers hear (a hidden-legend fieldset), and no status strip

items.before: The 'Before the consignment is imported' list now says 'upload the ITAHC and any other required documents'. It shows only when no uploaded document is an ITAHC or health certificate, even if other documents were uploaded; before, any uploaded document hid it. 'How to view or amend this notification' now reads 'You can view or change this notification from your dashboard.'
items.after:
The 'Before the consignment is imported' list now says 'upload the ITAHC and any other required documents'.

It shows only when no uploaded document is an ITAHC or health certificate.

It still shows if other documents were uploaded.

Before, any uploaded document hid it.

'How to view or amend this notification' now reads 'You can view or change this notification from your dashboard.'

items.before: Submitting records its date and outstanding items, and a notification still missing its health certificate shows as 'Submitted action required'
items.after: Submitting a notification records its date and its outstanding items. A notification still missing its health certificate shows as 'Submitted action required'.

items.before: The 'contact HMRC' and 'Find out about call charges' links on the submitted page now open in a new tab. The words '(opens in a new tab)' are read out by screen readers but are not shown on screen.
items.after:
These links on the submitted page now open in a new tab:

- 'contact HMRC'
- 'Find out about call charges'

Screen readers read out the words '(opens in a new tab)'.

The words are not shown on screen.

items.before: Before, opening the submitted page for a notification not yet submitted went to the overview. Now it goes to the declaration page, in live animals and plants. 'Return to your dashboard' already went to the set's own notification list and has not changed.
items.after:
Before, opening the submitted page for a notification not yet submitted went to the overview.

Now it goes to the declaration page, in live animals and plants.

'Return to your dashboard' has not changed.

It already went to the set's own notification list.
